signal: DataGrail introduced Risk Register and Vera, a complete AI privacy agent, as part of its 2026 product vision for proactive AI-era privacy risk management

email.body1:
Christopher, saw DataGrail launched Risk Register and Vera, your AI privacy agent, as part of the 2026 product vision.

New AI products usually surface more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and the signal-to-action lag is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DataGrail off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christopher, quick follow-up for DataGrail.

As GTM ops, the bottleneck is rarely finding intent, it is acting on it fast enough before it goes stale, so good accounts age out of the funnel. Tighter, faster outreach is usually the cheapest lift available.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and our best practices alone typically lift response rates 50-70 percent.
email.body3:
Christopher, last bit of proof for DataGrail.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DataGrail reply rate likely compares to peer privacy-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christopher, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency is not a priority right now, no problem. Shipping a new AI product line is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a GTM-ops motion? I will tailor it to DataGrail either way.
